cover_headline: Justice Department Lets Stand Ruling That H-1B-Only Job Ads Are Not Illegal Alone
facts: Attorney General Todd Blanche let lapse the 60-day window to review an August 12 decision by an administrative law judge
Thirteen House Republicans, led by Paul Gosar and Chip Roy, had asked the Justice Department on October 9 to take up the case
Indians make up the largest share of H-1B visa holders, accounting for more than 70 per cent of approved petitions in recent years

end.headline: Justice Department Lets Stand Ruling That H-1B-Only Job Ads Are Not Illegal Alone
end.line: An administrative ruling dismissing a complaint over a Chicago H-1B jobs board survives after Attorney General Todd Blanche declined review, narrowing how targeted ads can be challenged.
